name: Power
description: Power: a product of equal factors written aⁿ, where a is the base and n the exponent; for example 1.05³ = 1.05 · 1.05 · 1.05.

name: Proportional quantities
description: Proportional quantities: two quantities whose ratio is always the same, so when one is doubled, so is the other.

name: Coordinate system
description: Coordinate system: two number axes at right angles, the x-axis and the y-axis, crossing at the origin; a point is given by its coordinates (x, y).

name: Slope and constant term
description:
Slope: how much y changes when x increases by 1; in y = ax + b it is a.
Constant term: the value of y where the line crosses the y-axis; in y = ax + b it is b.

name: Draw a straight line from its equation
description: draw the line y = ax + b from a table of values or from the slope and constant term, and read the slope and constant term off a drawn line.

name: Percentage
description: Percentage: a number of hundredths, so 40 % means 40 out of 100, which is 0.40 as a decimal.

name: Calculate a percentage of an amount
description: find a given percentage of an amount, and find what percentage one amount is of another.

name: Calculate a percentage change
description: calculate an increase or decrease as a percentage of the original value, and tell which value is the original.

name: Percentage point
description: Percentage point: the unit for the difference between two percentages; going from 20 % to 25 % is a rise of 5 percentage points, which is a rise of 25 %.

name: Explain the difference between percent and percentage points
description: describe a change between two percentages both in percentage points and in percent, and say which one a given claim uses.

name: Growth factor
description: Growth factor: the number the old value is multiplied by to get the new value; an increase of p % gives 1 + p/100, and a decrease of p % gives 1 − p/100.

name: Calculate with a growth factor
description: find the new value, the original value or the percentage change when one of them is unknown, using the growth factor, for both increases and decreases.

name: Calculate repeated percentage changes
description: calculate the result of several percentage changes in a row by multiplying their growth factors, and use a power of the growth factor when the same change happens n times.

name: Model a situation with percentage growth
description: set up an expression of the form start value · growth factorⁿ for something that grows or shrinks by a fixed percentage each period, use it to find a value, and explain what each number in it means.

name: Model percentage growth in a spreadsheet
description: build a spreadsheet where each row applies the growth factor to the row above, and use it to find when the value passes a given limit.

name: Equation and solution
description:
Equation: a statement that two expressions are equal, where at least one contains an unknown.
Solution: a value of the unknown that makes the two sides equal.

name: Solve a linear equation
description: solve a linear equation, including ones with brackets and fractions, by doing the same to both sides, and check the answer by putting it back in.

name: Rearrange a formula
description: rearrange a formula to find a different quantity, and then calculate it with given values and units.

name: Solve a proportion
description: solve an equation where two ratios are equal, such as x/12 = 5/8, and set one up from two proportional quantities.

name: Set up an equation from a practical problem
description: choose what the unknown stands for, write an equation that describes a practical problem, solve it, and answer the question in a sentence with units.

name: System of equations
description: System of equations: two equations with two unknowns that must hold at the same time; its solution is the pair of values that satisfies both.

name: Solve a system of two linear equations
description: solve a system of two linear equations by substitution or elimination, and check the solution in both equations.

name: Solve a system of equations graphically
description: draw both equations as lines in the same coordinate system, read the solution off the intersection, and explain why the intersection is the solution.

name: Solve a practical problem with a system of equations
description: set up a system of two equations from a practical situation, solve it, and say what the solution means in that situation.

name: Inequality
description: Inequality: a statement that one expression is less than or greater than another, written with <, >, ≤ or ≥; its solution is usually a whole range of values.

name: Solve a linear inequality
description: solve a linear inequality, turning the sign around when multiplying or dividing by a negative number, and show the solution on a number line.

name: Compare strategies for solving equations
description: solve the same equation, system or inequality in two different ways, such as algebraically and with a graph or by systematic trying, argue why each step is valid, and say which way suits the problem best.

name: Price index
description: Price index: a number that shows the price level in one year compared with a base year, whose index is 100; an index of 125 means prices are 25 % higher than in the base year.

name: Calculate prices with a price index
description: calculate what a price in one year corresponds to in another year, or find a missing index, using that price divided by index is the same in both years.

name: Krone value
description: Krone value: what one krone from a given year is worth in the kroner of the base year, found as 100 divided by the price index.

name: Calculate krone value
description: calculate the krone value from a price index, and explain why the krone value falls when the price index rises.

name: Nominal and real wage
description:
Nominal wage: the wage in the kroner actually paid out.
Real wage: the wage converted to the kroner of a base year, which shows what the wage can actually buy.

name: Calculate real wage
description: calculate the real wage from the nominal wage and the price index, and decide whether purchasing power rose or fell between two years and by what percentage.

name: Gross and net income
description:
Gross income: income before tax and other deductions.
Net income: what is left after tax and other deductions are taken off.

name: Calculate net income
description: calculate net pay from gross pay with a percentage tax deduction or a tax table, and express the tax as a percentage of gross pay.

name: Explain how price index, krone value and real wage are connected
description: explain, with an example in numbers, what happens to the krone value and the real wage when the price index rises faster than the nominal wage, and why net income tells more than gross income about what a household can buy.

name: Set up a budget
description: set up a monthly budget from net income and expenses, find the surplus or deficit, and suggest a change that would balance it.

name: Interest and interest rate
description:
Interest: what it costs to borrow money, or what you earn on savings, in kroner.
Interest rate: the interest for one year as a percentage of the amount owed or saved.

name: Repayment and instalment
description:
Repayment: the part of a loan payment that reduces the debt.
Instalment: the whole payment for one period, that is repayment plus interest and fees.

name: Effective interest rate
description: Effective interest rate: the total yearly cost of a loan, interest and fees together, as a percentage of the amount borrowed; it is the rate that makes loans comparable.

name: Serial loan and annuity loan
description:
Serial loan: a loan where the repayment is the same every period, so the instalments fall as the interest falls.
Annuity loan: a loan where the instalment is the same every period, so the interest share falls and the repayment share rises.

name: Set up a repayment plan for a serial loan
description: calculate the repayment, interest, instalment and remaining debt for each period of a serial loan, and the total interest paid.

name: Compare a serial loan and an annuity loan
description: read the repayment plans for a serial loan and an annuity loan of the same size, and compare the instalments over time and the total cost.

name: Calculate the cost of credit card debt
description: calculate how an unpaid credit card debt grows with a monthly interest rate, using the growth factor, and compare the cost with that of a cheaper loan.

name: Assess a personal finance choice
description: assess a choice such as buying on credit, taking out a loan or saving first, using calculated costs and a budget, and argue for a recommendation and what it means later on.

name: Categorical and numerical data
description:
Categorical data: observations that are categories, such as favourite sport.
Numerical data: observations that are numbers, such as height in centimetres.

name: Frequency and relative frequency
description:
Frequency: how many times a value or category occurs in a data set.
Relative frequency: the frequency as a share of all observations, often written as a percentage.

name: Cumulative frequency
description: Cumulative frequency: the number of observations up to and including a given value or class.

name: Make a frequency table
description: sort a data set into a frequency table with columns for frequency, relative frequency and cumulative frequency.

name: Class and class midpoint
description:
Class: an interval that numerical observations are sorted into, such as 160–170 cm.
Class midpoint: the middle of a class, used to stand in for every observation in it.

name: Mean, median and mode
description:
Mean: the sum of the observations divided by how many there are.
Median: the middle observation when they are sorted by size, or the mean of the two middle ones.
Mode: the value that occurs most often.

name: Calculate mean, median and mode
description: calculate the mean, median and mode from a list of observations and from a frequency table.

name: Calculate the mean of grouped data
description: estimate the mean from a grouped frequency table using class midpoints, find the class the median lies in, and explain why the mean is only an estimate.

name: Range and interquartile range
description:
Range: the largest observation minus the smallest.
Quartiles: the values that split the sorted observations into four equal parts, with the median in the middle.
Interquartile range: the upper quartile minus the lower quartile, the spread of the middle half.

name: Calculate range and interquartile range
description: find the range, the quartiles and the interquartile range of a data set.

name: Standard deviation
description: Standard deviation: a measure of how far the observations typically lie from the mean; the larger it is, the more spread out the data.

name: Calculate standard deviation
description: calculate the standard deviation of a small data set using a table of deviations from the mean, squared deviations and their sum.

name: Outlier
description: Outlier: an observation that lies far from the rest of the data set.

name: Choose suitable measures of centre and spread
description: choose the measure of centre and the measure of spread that best describe a given data set, for example the median and interquartile range when there are outliers, and justify the choice.

name: Draw and read statistical diagrams
description: choose a bar chart, pie chart, line chart or histogram that suits the data, draw it with labelled axes, and read values from it.

name: Judge a statistical presentation
description: judge whether a diagram or a claim about data in the media is misleading, for example through a cut-off axis, a small sample, the wrong measure or percent mixed up with percentage points, and say how it should be presented.

name: Calculate statistical measures in a spreadsheet
description: use spreadsheet functions to find the measures of centre and spread of a data set, and make a diagram of it.

name: Analyse and present findings in a data set
description: analyse a data set from the local community or the media with suitable tables, diagrams and measures, and present what it shows, and what it cannot show, in a few clear sentences.

name: Convert between units
description: convert between units of length, area and volume, such as m to cm, m² to cm² and dm³ to litres.

name: Angles in triangles and quadrilaterals
description:
Angle sum of a triangle: the three angles of any triangle add up to 180°.
Angle sum of a quadrilateral: the four angles of any quadrilateral add up to 360°.
Right angle: an angle of 90°.

name: Perimeter, area and volume
description:
Perimeter: the length all the way round a plane figure.
Area: how much surface a figure covers, measured in square units such as m².
Volume: how much space a solid takes up, measured in cubic units such as m³ or in litres.

name: Calculate perimeter and area of plane figures
description: calculate the perimeter and area of rectangles, triangles, parallelograms, trapeziums, circles and figures made up of these.

name: Calculate volume and surface area
description: calculate the volume and surface area of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones and spheres, and give volumes in litres where it suits.

name: Pythagoras' theorem
description: Pythagoras' theorem: in a right-angled triangle, the square on the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares on the two shorter sides, a² + b² = c².

name: Calculate a side with Pythagoras' theorem
description: calculate an unknown side in a right-angled triangle, whether it is the hypotenuse or one of the shorter sides, and check whether a triangle is right-angled.

name: Similar figures
description: Similar figures: figures with the same shape, where matching angles are equal and matching sides are in the same ratio.

name: Calculate sides in similar figures
description: show that two triangles are similar by comparing their angles, and find an unknown side by setting up a proportion.

name: Scale
description: Scale: the ratio between a length on a map or drawing and the matching real length, written 1 : n or n : 1.

name: Calculate with scale
description: calculate real lengths from a map or drawing and the other way round, and find the scale from a drawn and a real length, converting units on the way.

name: Calculate how area and volume change in an enlargement
description: calculate how area and volume change when all lengths are multiplied by k, using that area changes by k² and volume by k³.

name: Plan a practical task with geometry
description: plan a practical task, such as a scale drawing of a room or how much material a job needs, by choosing the measurements and calculations it needs, and answer with units and sensible rounding.
